title: French Lamb Stew with Berbere Spice
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from France, infused with the bold flavors of Ethiopian berbere spice.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add remaining 1 tbsp olive oil. Add chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped carrots and potatoes, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add berbere spice, red wine, beef broth, and browned lamb. Stir to combine.
Bring stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2.5 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
